rules.name: Rule_VaricoseVeins_ExplicitVeins
rules.description: Matches texts explicitly mentioning visible, prominent, or noticeable veins/blood vessels, allowing for flexible phrasing (adjective before or after noun), especially in the legs or calves, potentially with associated symptoms like swelling, discomfort, or general factors like being overweight.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: Rule_VaricoseVeins_CrampsAndContext
rules.description: Matches texts describing cramps in the calves or legs, allowing for either order of 'cramps' and 'legs/calves', especially when associated with frequent occurrence, prolonged activity (standing, walking, exercising) or being overweight/obese.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: Rule_VaricoseVeins_LegSwelling
rules.description: Matches texts about swelling in the legs or calves, often linked to being overweight, obesity, difficulty with footwear, worsening over time, or discomfort when sitting.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: Rule_VaricoseVeins_LegRashWithoutPsoriasisMarkers
rules.description: Matches texts describing a rash, inflamed, or red skin on the legs or calves causing discomfort, but explicitly excludes keywords commonly associated with psoriasis.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: Rule_VaricoseVeins_LegPainFromActivity
rules.description: Matches texts describing general discomfort, pain, or aching in the legs, calves, or feet, especially when related to standing, walking, sitting, running, physical activities, or associated with long durations.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: Rule_Psoriasis_SkinSymptoms
rules.description: Matches texts describing core psoriasis skin manifestations like peeling, scaly, flaky, cracks, fissures, thickened skin, silver-like dusting, or rash. It is flexible to capture these symptoms on typical affected areas (knees, elbows, scalp, palms, soles, etc.) in various word orders, or as general 'skin' or 'rash' symptoms.
rules.label: psoriasis

rules.name: Rule_Psoriasis_NailJointSpecific
rules.description: Matches texts indicating specific psoriasis symptoms related to nails (dents, pits, cracks, inflammation) or joint pain/agony/ache. It is flexible to capture 'dents' before or after 'nails'.
rules.label: psoriasis

rules.name: Rule_Psoriasis_WinterSensitivity
rules.description: Matches texts describing skin conditions, particularly rashes, that worsen in winter months or dry air, or are sensitive to temperature/humidity changes, often associated with psoriasis.
rules.label: psoriasis
